faces.name: The Wondrous Architect
faces.oracleText:
If The Wondrous Architect is your commander, your deck may have any number of cards named Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower. For each one that isn't in your deck, you may choose a basic land card to become that card before the game begins. (For example, each Mountain in your deck is an Urza's Mine and each Forest is an Urza's Tower.)
Whenever The Wonderous Architect enters or attacks, create a token that's a copy of one of the following, chosen at random: Dark Sphere, Aladdin's Lamp, Jayemdae Tome, Chaos Orb, Time Vault, or Sol Ring.

faces.name: The World Spell
faces.oracleText:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Look at the top seven cards of your library. You may reveal a non-Saga permanent card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
III — Put up to two non-Saga permanent cards from your hand onto the battlefield.

faces.name: The World Tree
faces.oracleText:

{T}: Add {G}.

{W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for any number of God cards, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

faces.name: The Wrath of Khan
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — This Saga deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls. At the beginning of the next combat this turn, gain control of that creature until end of turn. Untap it. It gains haste until end of turn.
II — You may exile a card from your hand. If you do, draw a card.
III — Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent of their choice.
